record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: RATTATA and RATICATE declare AGILITY (passive NONE in the catalog). Other units are not covered.
record.summary: Self buff, no target and no damage: the caster's speed stat is raised by a requested 10/20/30/60 (by stars; 10 for RATTATA 1 star, 20 for RATICATE 2 stars) through addSpeed with apBoost 1 and the cast's crit flag. A held Big Eater Belt first multiplies the requested value by 1.25 (rounded down to an integer); then the value is multiplied by (1 + AP/100) and by critPower when the cast crit; the result is added to speed, which is clamped between 0 and 300 (MAX_SPEED). The buff is applied to the combat entity only (permanent false) and the default ability animation is suppressed.

targeting.note: requiresTarget is false so the cast does not wait for a target in range; the target argument is typed null. How casting is triggered otherwise was not read.

effects.scaling: requested boost x Big Eater Belt 1.25 (rounded down, only if the caster holds BIG_EATER_BELT) x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false). Twist Band does not apply: the value is positive and the caster is on its own team.
effects.resolution: Requested = table value; applied change = the scaled value, but speed ends at clamp(speed + value, 0, 300), so the change is smaller when the caster is near 300. A MELMETAL-passive entity would convert it to 0.5 x attack instead; RATTATA and RATICATE have no passive in the catalog, so that branch is not taken. Applies to the combat entity only; the board Pokémon keeps its base speed.

buffs.duration: none found in this strategy: permanent for the rest of the fight unless something else changes it

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 30 and 60 entries are not reachable by the two units' bare star counts (1, 2). maxPP 100 and range 1 for both.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast adds again (stacking) until the 300 cap; nothing is removed by this strategy.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: speed +10 (RATTATA) / +20 (RATICATE). Requested value passes Big Eater Belt (x1.25 down) and AP/crit scaling; applied change is bounded by the 0..300 speed clamp. No damage, no heal, no status.
